slice_contract.real_problem: M8-I removed the prompt-only Flash classifier and established one Host-owned typed policy, but Auto has no formal same-revision quality or efficiency evidence against fixed Pro. The current interactive TUI also discards an explicit reasoning setting whenever model=auto, contradicting the accepted explicit-reasoning contract.
acceptance: crates/app remains the only production Auto policy owner and crates/deepseek remains only the official model capability, Chat planner, transport, parser, retry, usage, and cost owner
explicit model and explicit reasoning selections survive CLI, TUI, HTTP, and stdio projection unchanged

Auto root is Pro; ordinary read-only child is Flash; typed read-only recheck is Pro; explicit isolated Writer is Pro; no route uses an LLM classifier, prompt keyword, character threshold, Provider, product mode, or mid-run switch

each child selection is frozen in AgentTask and exactly bound to RunRequest; ModelRouteAudit, selected model/reasoning, actor authority, request accounting, and execution fingerprint reopen without rerouting
root-only, explicit Writer, and crash/reopen paths pass conformance even where Auto and fixed Pro have no model surface delta

a formal paid comparison is admitted only after one immutable current binary exposes fixed Pro, fixed Flash, and Host Auto with the same task, tools, budgets, verifier, retry policy, and complete billing
replaces: the TUI-only rule that silently rewrites an explicit reasoning selection to auto when model=auto
cutover_deletion: delete the TUI reasoning rewrite before the formal candidate is frozen

do not restore crates/deepseek/src/auto_route.rs, classifier prompt/parser, recent_context, keyword or 500-character heuristics, provider inventory, unknown-billing pre-route recovery, or a production experiment toggle
delete any M9-A-only live runner/test path after the decision if it has no independent production or regression consumer

current_surface_audit.paid_delta_boundary: Auto differs from fixed Pro only when a current Run creates an ordinary read-only child. Root-only and ordinary Writer runs are offline conformance strata, not paid benefit cells.

offline_matrix: TUI model=auto preserves explicit off/high/max reasoning exactly like exec and app-server
explicit Pro and Flash root/child inheritance remains exact
Auto root, ordinary read-only child, typed recheck, ordinary Writer, and typed rework resolve only from typed actor/authority/evidence facts
AgentTask and child RunRequest bind exact model, reasoning, route audit, workspace authority, limits, and tool policy
pending Start, root model in-flight, read-only child, Writer, verifier, and terminal SIGKILL/reopen do not reroute or duplicate requests
root/read-only/Writer RequestPlan and accounting rebuild exactly from SQLite
CLI/TUI/HTTP/stdio share one requested model/reasoning contract
no auto_route module, classifier prompt/parser, recent_context, prompt heuristic, Provider, second Runtime, second Store, or experiment production variant exists

same_across_arms: source revision, source tree, Cargo.lock, rust toolchain, release binary bytes and binary SHA-256
TaskContract, user prompt, fixture bytes, deterministic verifier, workspace slot identity and Git seed
official ChatCompletions endpoint, streaming, retry policy, tool catalog, permissions, request/output/turn/tool/wall budgets
formal_experiment.schedule: balanced three-variant rotation inside each task and repetition; every arm begins from the same pair-owned fixture bytes and a separate State/RunStore

tasks.stratum: multi-file capability intersection followed by one verified implementation
cross-component dependency investigation followed by one verified implementation
layered policy and locked-key counterexamples followed by one verified implementation

quality: Host Auto verified success is not lower than fixed Pro in any task cell
Host Auto false success is zero
no pair is fixed-Pro success and Host-Auto failure
all Host Auto arms contain exactly one Pro root route, exactly two ordinary Flash read-only child routes, and a Pro root integration route
all fixed-Pro arms use Pro for root and both children; all fixed-Flash arms use Flash for root and both children
TaskContract, verifier, evidence completion, latest revision, route audit, request ledger, replay, and billing remain valid
accounting: every physical start has a typed response/usage disposition
billing_unknown=false, accounting complete=true, usage_complete=true, in_flight=0, and all official prices are fixture-known
any unknown billing, unsealed accounting, identity mismatch, observer failure, safety ambiguity, or incomplete cell stops the suite without retry, mate completion, resampling, or splicing
efficiency_after_quality: Host Auto total known cost or wall time improves by at least 20 percent versus fixed Pro
the chosen improvement direction is stable in paired task/repetition results rather than produced by one outlier
the net code-complexity delta remains positive after deleting experiment-only paths

decision_rule.admit_default_auto: only if every quality/accounting gate passes and at least one efficiency gate passes
decision_rule.otherwise: keep product default fixed deepseek-v4-pro; keep explicit models; keep Host Auto as hold; Flash remains explicit and a typed read-only investigation model
non_conclusions: official model positioning does not prove CodeWhale task quality
the fixed Flash diagnostic cannot substitute for fixed Pro non-inferiority
root-only and Writer conformance cannot be counted as Auto efficiency wins because they have no model delta
no step-level cascade, learned router, root Flash, hidden recheck, or classifier restoration is admitted

research_review.use: Research motivates harness-state routing, abstention, and reliable quality estimation; it does not override CodeWhale's fixed-Pro quality gate.
